children: Bitcoin starts the Asia session on a more positive note, as a rebound in tech helps lift cryptocurrencies. Asian chip and artificial-intelligence-related stocks are broadly higher in early trade, while e-Mini Nasdaq futures rise 1.3% after Nvidia earnings. Still, Bitcoin remains around three-month lows, and has yet to reclaim the key $65,000 level as a combination of dollar strength, expectations for higher rates and volatility keeps buyers at bay. Bitcoin has gone through a washout, Glassnode Research says, and broad demand is still missing, with stablecoins shrinking, miners selling and money leaving ETFs. The block of buyers built between $62,00 and $66,00 is now the line to watch. Bitcoin rises 0.7% to $64,734; ethereum gains 0.7% to $1,818; solana sits 2.3% higher. (fabiana.negrinochoa@wsj.com)
